name: Motor Driven Cycle
description: A motorcycle or motor scooter whose motor produces 5 horsepower (3,750 W) or less. An electric two- or three-wheeler past the e-bike and moped limits lands here until its motor exceeds 5 horsepower.

restrictions.rule: A motorcycle, including any motor scooter: a seat or saddle, and no more than three wheels on the ground
Its motor produces 5 horsepower (3,750 W) or less
A pedal electric bike that can exceed 25 mph or 1.5 brake horsepower is too much for a moped and lands here

Riders need a class M license or a motorcycle endorsement, so must be at least 16; under 18 they must hold a motorcycle instruction permit for six months and complete an approved course or 30 certified hours of practice
Riders and passengers under 18 must wear a helmet, and every rider must wear glasses, goggles or a face shield unless it has a windshield
Must have a rearview mirror, seat and footrests
Titled and registered with MVD, and must carry liability insurance
